body.en:
• Gym, golf, and other exercise day notes now have Start / Stop — stop fills duration for you (you can still type it).
• After you update, you'll see a short What's new note once (this one).
• New installs default to English. Your existing language setting is unchanged.
• Demo examples now match the built-in activities (gym, golf, reading).
body.zh-Hant:
• 健身、高爾夫同其他運動嘅當日筆記而家有開始／停止——撳停止會幫你填好時長（你仍然可以自己打）。
• 更新之後會出一次簡短嘅更新說明（就係呢張）。
• 新安裝預設用英文。你而家嘅語言設定唔會改。
• 示範例子而家同內置活動一致（健身、高爾夫、睇書）。
